description: Checks whether ChatGPT and Claude recommend a product when people ask which tool to use. It reads the product's homepage, writes 5 questions a buyer in its category would ask, asks each AI, and reports how often the product is named and in what position, which competitors are named instead, which websites the answers cite, three suggested fixes, and a link to the full shareable report. Takes about a minute. A site checked in the last 7 days returns that report instead of asking again.

category.description: Optional: what kind of product it is, like 'uptime monitoring tool'. Read from the homepage when left out.

website.description: The product's website, like acme.com (a full URL works too).

name: check_ai_visibility
title: Check AI visibility
